artworks.title: La route de Rocquencourt (The Road to Rocquencourt)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features a landscape with an elevated viewpoint, looking down a slight slope toward a house on the right partially hidden by foliage. The horizon is low in the image, faintly visible in the distance. The brushstrokes are loose and expressive, creating texture in the foliage and grass. The color palette is primarily sepia tones. There are bushes on the left and a figure seated near a path. The sky occupies the upper half of the image.

artworks.title: Avocat compulsant un dossier (Lawyer Going through a Brief)
artworks.medium: etching in blue on laid Van Gelder paper

artworks.title: Avocat compulsant un dossier (Lawyer Going through a Brief)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts three individuals, each showing three-quarters of their bodies. The person on the right is bending forward, looking down with their hands resting on a surface. They wear a dark coat and a hat obscuring their facial features. The middle person has their head covered with a slightly visible face. The person on the left, likely a child, is leaning over the ledge with their head slightly tilted downwards and short hair. None of the individuals hold any objects. The background is mostly dark with cross-hatched shading for depth, contrasting with the lighter figures. The drawing is monochromatic with dark tones emphasizing the characters' focus.

artworks.title: Un caboulet à montmartre (A Dive at Montmartre)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals. Two people are seated at a table in the foreground with their upper bodies visible. They wear hats and have curly hair. Another person stands to the left, only partially visible in a coat with pronounced collars. The fourth figure stands in the background with hair pulled back, dressed simply. The setting is suggested by vertical lines, and there is a small cup or bowl on the table. The image has a sketch-like quality with freeform line work.

artworks.title: Le Christ dépouillé de ses vêtements (Christ Stripped of His Clothes)
artworks.medium: drypoint in brown on wove Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures. One figure is bending slightly, and the other figure is standing close by. The drawing uses lines and cross-hatching to depict the forms and shadows of the figures. The surrounding area includes faintly drawn additional figures and a long rectangular shape on the ground. The lines in the drawing convey movement and create a sense of drama and tension.

artworks.title: Le Christ dépouillé de ses vêtements (Christ Stripped of His Clothes)
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures. The central figure appears to be collapsed or burdened, surrounded by other engaging figures. On the left, a kneeling figure seems to be in a posture of offering. The background shows other figures observing the scene. The drawing uses dynamic lines, shadow, and hatching for intensity.

artworks.title: Le Christ aux outrages (The Mocking of Christ)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three individuals, with their upper bodies visible. The person on the right is seated and faces slightly to the left, wearing a crown of thorns. This figure has distinct features, a somber expression, full beard, and long hair. The person in the middle has their head turned towards the central figure, with a mustache and hair covered by a turban or thick scarf. The third figure, positioned lower and closer to the left, is smaller in scale with less distinct facial features. The background is minimally detailed, suggesting a simple interior with a hint of a window or door frame in the top right corner.

artworks.title: Après l'apparition (2e planche) (After the Vision) (second plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a dining table with various items on it. The table is covered with a cloth and has bread, a bowl, and cups or mugs placed on it. Two figures are interacting with the items on the table, suggesting intimacy or companionship. The drawing technique uses crosshatched lines to outline shapes and shades. The background consists of abstract lines that provide texture and depth to the space. The illustration focuses on the interplay of light and shadow, conveying the mood of a moment centered around companionship at the table.

artworks.title: Après l'apparition (2e planche) (After the Vision) (second plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a table setting with objects and figures around it. The drawing illustrates a table covered with a cloth, featuring plates, bread, and a bottle. A wooden chair is placed on the left side, while two figures are seated closely together on the right. Their forms are depicted with loose lines indicating a sense of intimacy. The surroundings and details are suggested with minimal line work, creating a gentle atmosphere. Movement and texture are conveyed through the use of line, directing the viewer's focus to the center of the drawing.

artworks.title: Le repos du modèle (4e planche) (The Model's Rest) (fourth plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows two people, one fully nude and in a prone position on the floor, and the other seated beside them. The nude person is shown from the side, kneeling on a fabric or drapery, with their arms outstretched on a flat surface. Their head is turned slightly away, emphasizing shoulder-length, wavy hair. The other individual, seated next to the first, seems engaged in an act of drawing or observing the nude figure. This person's features are indistinct with a noticeable beard and subtly defined hair. The seated figure is dressed in loose clothing, suggested by flowing lines. The background features dense cross-hatching, creating a shadowed space contrasting with lighter, less textured areas, giving a sense of depth to the scene in the foreground.

artworks.title: Dans le parc de Versailles (1ère planche) (In the Park at Versailles) (first plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch-like view from a slightly elevated angle, focusing on a sparse landscape. The horizon is defined by a low wall with archway-like openings. Light vegetation is suggested by quick, impressionistic strokes indicating trees. The loose, gestural brushwork features a restrained color palette of soft sepia tones. Simple lines suggest a road or path leading towards the wall.

artworks.title: Femme assise de profil (Woman Seated in Profile)
artworks.medium: etching (zinc plate) on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing an upper-body view of a person seated in profile facing left. The person is leaning slightly forward with their head tilted downward. The facial features are not distinct, but the outline suggests a woman with a delicate face. The person has an elaborate updo with curls and waves. Their clothing is loose and draped, indicated by soft, flowing lines. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is shaded with hatched lines for depth and contrast.

artworks.title: La fraction du pain (The Breaking of the Bread)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals seated at a table. Two people are facing away from the viewer while the third is depicted sitting at the left side of the table with their hands resting on the table, looking slightly upward. This person has long hair, a beard, and is wearing a loose, flowing garment. The other two individuals are facing the third person, their heads slightly bowed. All individuals appear to be wearing robes. The background is simple and monochrome. The sketchy, linear style creates a shadowed effect around the figures.

artworks.title: Avant le repas à Emmaus (1ère planche) (Before the Supper at Emmaus) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of five individuals in a sketch drawing. Four figures are seated, with two on the left side and two on the right. One person stands in the center leaning over a table. The person standing is shown in profile with their head bent slightly forward. Facial features are not clearly defined due to the sketch style. On the right side, a seated figure resembles Jesus with long hair and a beard, draped in clothing that pools around bare feet. Next to them, another seated person has long hair. On the left side, two figures are seated—one is a child on a woman's lap, both looking towards the center. The clothing is loose and flowing, depicted with sketchy lines. The background is plain, lacking additional context. The sketch is done in a linear style with sparse details, focusing on the figures' positioning and clothing.

artworks.title: Le repas à Emmaus (2e planche) (The Supper at Emmaus) (second plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of four individuals seated at a table. Two individuals are seen from the waist up. One is leaning forward with their head on their forearm, while the other, with short, curly hair and pronounced facial features, faces the viewer with a solemn expression. The third individual is partially obscured and looking down, while the fourth individual leans over the table, possibly resting their elbows on it, with a beard and balding head and a focused expression. All individuals wear indistinct clothing, and the background consists of vertical and diagonal lines suggesting a simple indoor setting.

artworks.title: Le repas à Emmaus (3e planche) (The Supper at Emmaus) (third plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an etching of four individuals. One person on the left holds an infant. The central figure is seated and the person on the right is standing. Another individual leans over a table in the foreground. The background consists of dense cross-hatching. A table with a round object is in the foreground.

artworks.title: La rencontre sous la voute (1ère planche) (The Meeting under the Arch) (first plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of three figures under an archway. The figures are close together, with two facing away from the viewer and one facing them. They are wearing loose robes or garments. The background shows a rural setting with buildings and bare trees. The archway is made of brick or stone. There are no visible details on the figures' faces.

artworks.title: La rencontre sous la voute (2e planche) (The Meeting under the Arch) (second plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from a side view. They are positioned close together, with one turning slightly towards the other, suggesting they are engaged in conversation. The left person wears a hat and a dark, heavy coat, their face partially visible, revealing a beard and mustache. The right person has long hair and a full beard, depicted in a lighter sketch, and their face is also detailed slightly, with a gentle expression. The two figures stand next to an arched stone wall. The background is a minimalist, blank canvas.

artworks.title: La rencontre sous la voute (3e planche) (The Meeting under the Arch) (third plate)
artworks.medium: etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing under an arch or shadowy area on the right side. The person on the left is slightly hunched, using a walking stick, and wears a large brimmed hat. The person on the right stands closer, facing the first person. Both individuals wear long, flowing garments, with one possibly wearing a lighter-colored outfit. The setting appears to be outdoor, with faint lines suggesting distant structures on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Femme nue passant sa chemise (Nude Woman Taking Off Her Chemise)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a person's body in a side view, with their head turned downward. The person is in a seated, crouched position, with knees bent and body slightly leaning forward. The facial features are suggested rather than detailed, with closed eyes and relaxed features. The hair is long, flowing, and tousled, blending into the sketchy style of the drawing. The person appears unclothed, with emphasis on the contours of the body created by soft, curving lines. There are no visible jewelry or objects held in their hands. The background is plain, with no distinct setting, comprised of a series of hatching and cross-hatching lines.

artworks.title: Femme nue vue de dos (Nude Woman Seen from the Back)
artworks.medium: drypoint and etching on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman's body viewed three-quarters from the back, sitting with her shoulders turned towards the viewer. Her face is in profile, looking over her shoulder. She has styled, voluminous dark hair and delicate facial features, emphasizing her eyes and nose. The woman is not wearing any clothing, and her form is depicted using fine linework and crosshatching for depth and texture. There are no visible jewelry or objects. The background features abstract, energetic patterns of intricate cross-hatched lines around the woman.

artworks.title: En cabinet particulier (3e planche) (In a Private Room) (third plate)
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The sketch shows three individuals positioned in different ways. Two of them are women, partly nude, with one standing and the other leaning forward. The third figure is a man, partially visible from the neck up. The background is minimalistic.

artworks.title: Evanouissement à l'audience (Fainting at the Hearing)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of three people, depicted from the waist up. The person on the left is seated, wearing a helmet-like headpiece and flowing garment. The face is minimally detailed. The central figure is leaning back with distinct facial features such as a mustache. The person on the right stands, leaning over the seated figure, also lacking detailed facial features and dressed in a draped garment. The background is plain with light lines hinting at an indoor setting, devoid of additional elements.

artworks.title: Le Christ portant sa croix (4e planche) (Christ Carrying the Cross) (fourth plate)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brown on laid Van Gelder paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure carrying a wooden cross through a crowd. The image shows a central figure carrying the wooden cross, surrounded by indistinct profiles and shapes of a crowd and a ladder on the left. The composition uses strong lines, detailing the clothing folds and posture of the figure, conveying movement and struggle.
